name: metrictower/funnypot-mainnet-client
description: Client library for the funnypot-mainnet IP-reputation service (report + check).

suggest.ext-apcu: Cross-process verdict/breaker store on a bare-PHP host via ApcuCache (guard with ApcuCache::isUsable()).
suggest.ext-curl: Preferred HTTP transport; falls back to stream contexts when absent.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: For the bundled PdoSqliteReportQueue (report path only).
suggest.psr/simple-cache: Inject any PSR-16 cache as the verdict/breaker store via Psr16Cache.
